description: OpenStreetMap node/1483751824. The OpenStreetMap description says «Самолёт МиГ-15». THE DEDICATION IS TO THE 33rd FIGHTER AVIATION REGIMENT which was destroyed on the ground at Pruzhany on 22 June 1941 — eight years before the MiG-15 flew; the jet is a substitute for the I-16s and MiG-3s it commemorates and that is recorded here rather than allowed to corrupt the identity
